gbm_population_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma confirmed by pathology.

candidate_evidence.quote: This phase I/II clinical trial is intended to investigate the efficacy and safety of SVZ irradiation with postoperative radiotherapy in patients with GBM.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Newly diagnosed glioblastoma confirmed by pathology.

role_evidence.quote: Concurrent chemotherapy with temozolomide and six cycles of adjuvant temozolomide chemotherapy were performed at the same time as radiotherapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Radiotherapy-field trial (SVZ irradiation); temozolomide is standard concurrent/adjuvant backbone given to every patient at standard schedule, not the investigational question. No pharmacological candidate. Registry phase is NA though title says phase I/II. SVZ involvement on MRI is an imaging criterion, not a molecular biomarker.
